development_baseline.recipe: v9 (fold) + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then 0.3 * that + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all on every row outside LIRF, then 0.15 * v9 + 0.85 * ens_v22_lirf_q on matched LIRF non-population rows with ordinary clocks, floored: the v22 selection's lirf_q_85 on January/July/November (runs/adsb_v22_v1/selection.json) and the v20-recipe December read (docs/december/score_adsb_v22_v1.json, the v19 export's residual booster applied to December). The tool refuses to run if these do not reproduce. -- then, as v22: cross-fit v9 on clock-present rows, the twelve-month residual r12x, and 0.25 ens_v22_lirf_q on unmatched LIRF non-population rows

configuration.development_scheme: Leave-one-month-out over all twelve months of 2025 for the residual stage. For a held-out month every variant is fitted on the in-scope rows of the other eleven months (scratch/v24 frames: cross-fit v9 on clock-present rows, the provenance that ships; the label-free matches_v11 feature caches of adsb_v24) and predicts the held-out month. Reading 1 (all twelve months): the residual stage's own out-of-sample RMSE on its scope (matched non-LIRF rows, v9 + r against the label), pooled over the twelve months by rows. Reading 2 (the four recipe months, the only months with out-of-sample committee tables): every candidate is built with the frozen blend arithmetic (tools/run_adsb_v11.candidate_values) and scored on ALL rows (every label, no clipping) against the incumbent's development prediction, which the tool must reproduce exactly from runs/adsb_v24/dev/predictions_<month>.parquet. The blend tables are the incumbent's out-of-sample fold predictions (January / July / November) and the cached January-November refit leaves (December), identical for baseline and candidates. The eight other months score the residual stage only.

configuration.purpose: The residual stage of the v22 recipe, developed on a twelve-month leave-one-month-out: sample weights by calendar-month distance to the target month, a longer inner rounds cap, a CatBoost residual, and two-member means. Everything else (cross-fit / twelve-month v7, v9, the committee blend, the LIRF blends, the floor) is exactly v22. Motivation: docs/audit_20260922 (removing the residual stage costs +0.67 / +0.84 / +2.22 / +2.62% on Jan / Jul / Nov / Dec, 1.5x the committee's marginal value on the covered months; the residual learning curve showed adjacent months dominate; several inner folds of the shipped residual stopped at the 4,000-round cap).

residual_model.applies_to: v22's residual stage (matched rows outside LIRF, target label minus cross-fit v9, weight 1.0, single model); nothing else in the recipe changes
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the eleven training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, the variant's cap; sample weights apply to the training folds only, the inner validation is unweighted); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: the inner rule applied once per refit
residual_model.weights_rule: a variant with a `weights` scheme multiplies each training row's weight by the scheme value at the circular calendar-month distance between the row's month and the target month (the held-out month in development; the ranking row's calendar month, January or July, at export): {'1': w1, '2': w2, 'default': w}; every row of every training month is kept

adj2.note: adjacent months weighted 2, two months away 1.5

adj4.note: adjacent months weighted 4, two months away 2

cap8k.note: the control with the inner rounds cap raised to 8,000 (several shipped inner folds stopped at 4,000)

cat.note: CatBoost residual (depth 8, learning rate 0.05, l2 3, native categorical airport / stand / runway), same target, scope and inner rule

r12x.note: the shipped residual protocol, unchanged (control; on the four recipe months it repeats the adsb_v24 r12x fit)

configuration.selection: For each candidate: RMSE on each of the four recipe months versus the incumbent's development prediction, and the pooled twelve-month residual-scope RMSE of its residual versus the control's. Eligible when not worse on ANY recipe month (ratio <= 1.0), mean ratio over the four recipe months at most 0.9998 (0.02%), the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference below zero on every recipe month where the candidate differs from the baseline on at least one row, and the pooled residual-scope RMSE strictly below the control's. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio over the four recipe months (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v22. r12x_repro is a check and cannot be selected. Per-airport, ordinary-row and per-month scope figures are descriptive.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: every member variant of its residual is refit on ALL twelve months' in-scope rows (scratch/v24 frames, cross-fit v9) with rounds from the inner rule applied once per refit; an unweighted member gives one model; a weighted member gives two models, one per ranking target month (January: weights by circular distance from month 1; July: from month 7), and each ranking row takes the residual of its own calendar month's model; a mean candidate averages its members' residuals row by row. v9 on the ranking is exactly v22's (v9 from scratch, the twelve-month v7 of runs/adsb_v24/v7/refit on clock-present rows, the LIRF fill population and missing-clock rows unchanged); the blends are exactly v22's with the twelve-month ranking tables; floor -12; nearest-integer export as vigorous-whistle_v23.parquet through the frozen submission contract; verified by an independent re-implementation and audited (tools/audit_export.py); uploaded only with the user's approval; the official score against v22 (239.1335) is the final test.
